title: Sierra Leone ICA CMS — FSD knowledge graph

nodes.label: Sierra Leone CMS
nodes.summary: ICA Sierra Leone EMS-family PHPMaker CMS under sierraleone/<desk>/, all desks sharing MySQL ems_sierraleone. Sibling of Cyberjaya / Botswana but thinner: no dedicated marketing, accommodation, library, lecturer, CDU, notice or student self-service desks; sleonebatch/ is empty.
nodes.raisd: M5 expansion / pattern reference — not ADR-1 SoR. Portal API must stay campus-keyed (CAP-53); do not assume Botswana api_* parity.

nodes.label: Admissions
nodes.summary: Application centre (enquiry → application → course application → offer) and letter templates. Uses ac_* names, not Cyberjaya app_*.

nodes.label: Academic
nodes.summary: Registry and academic desks around student master, programmes, modules, timetable, assessment and attendance.

nodes.label: Commercial
nodes.summary: Finance desk: fee structures, invoices, payments, local assist, student loans and refunds. No government scholarship API.

nodes.label: Student life
nodes.summary: Student affairs only — visa, insurance claims and passport. Thin sa_* compared with Cyberjaya EMGS.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.summary: Settings, reports, in-app help and the zemail outbound email path to cmssupport.limkokwing.net.

nodes.label: applicationcenter/
nodes.summary: Enquiry, applications, course applications, eligibility, promotions and application fees (~218 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Applicant portal via Portal API — map ac_* aliases, not Cyberjaya app_* names.

nodes.label: lettertemplate/
nodes.summary: Letter templates used by admissions and registry (offer / student letters).
nodes.raisd: Document generation stays CMS-side until a Raisd letters capability is agreed.

nodes.label: registry/
nodes.summary: Student master, offers, forms and current-term population (~215 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Student + Staff portals — reuse the r_* mental model.

nodes.label: academic/
nodes.summary: Schools, programmes, modules, timetable, assessment and attendance (~202 PHP). Covers what Cyberjaya splits across faculty + lecturer desks.
nodes.raisd: Student / Lecturer / Staff academic surfaces via Portal API — reuse the f_* mental model.

nodes.label: finance/
nodes.summary: Fee structures, invoices, payments, assist, loans and refunds (~191 PHP). Local assist only — no TEF feature flag.
nodes.raisd: Student Finance read + Staff Bursary via Portal API.

nodes.label: studentaffair/
nodes.summary: Visa, insurance claims and passport (~77 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff Services surface; student visa view via Portal API.

nodes.label: setting/
nodes.summary: Institution, terms, fee catalogs, assessment / timetable setup and staff (~260 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Campus configuration input for CAP-53 campus keying.

nodes.label: reports/
nodes.summary: Population, enrolment, payment, scholarship, transcript and BOE reports (~231 PHP).

nodes.label: help/
nodes.summary: In-app help modules (~133 PHP).

nodes.label: zemail
nodes.summary: Outbound email via email.php / zemail/com.mh.func.app.email.php, pushing to the Limkokwing support host.
nodes.raisd: Replace with a campus-owned notification path under Portal API for Live; do not hard-wire Limkokwing support hosts.

nodes.label: cmssupport
nodes.summary: cmssupport.limkokwing.net — POST /support/emailserverapi.php and /support/pushsupport.php. Login also verifies Google reCAPTCHA.
nodes.raisd: External dependency to retire from the Live path.

nodes.label: r_student
nodes.summary: Shared student record hub in ems_sierraleone. Application centre and registry enrol; academic, finance and student affairs attach to it.
nodes.raisd: Identity and enrolment source for campus-keyed Portal API reads.

nodes.label: Portal API
nodes.summary: Raisd anti-corruption layer. No api_* stored-procedure hooks exist in Sierra Leone today, so M5 must add a campus-keyed ACL from scratch.

nodes.label: CAP-33
nodes.summary: Learner support and IT helpdesk.

nodes.label: CAP-45
nodes.summary: Finance balances, invoices and payment history.

nodes.label: CAP-47
nodes.summary: Online payment and financial documents.

nodes.label: CAP-48
nodes.summary: Scholarships and incentives (local assist; no government API).

nodes.label: CAP-50
nodes.summary: Immigration and visa processing.

nodes.label: CAP-53
nodes.summary: Existing CMS integration and campus configuration (campus-keyed ACL).
